# FG-REVIEW-0006

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_merge_whose_trial_merge_conflicts_is_superseded` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: マージの直前の確認で、ソースブランチとターゲットブランチが衝突していました。衝突を解消して push し直してから、もう一度マージしてください。
- en: When the merge was about to run, the source and target branches conflicted. Resolve the conflict, push again, then merge again.
- id: Saat merge akan dijalankan, branch sumber dan tujuan berkonflik. Selesaikan konflik, push lagi, lalu merge lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

The merge job (M3 R4, ADR-0024 §4.2 step 4) computed the trial merge of the merge request's head into the target's live tip under the repository's merge lock (`git merge-tree --write-tree`, never the stored mergeability status) and it conflicted: the target moved since the last mergeability check, or the check was stale. The merge attempt was set to `superseded`; no commit was made and no ref moved.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The job's log event `forge.review.merge_completed` carries `outcome=superseded`, `error_code=FG-REVIEW-0006`, `merge_id`, `merge_request_id`, `head_sha`, `target_sha`, `conflict_files` (count) and `files_truncated` (paths stay out of the event). Read the attempt: SELECT id, state, reason, error_code, head_sha, expected_old FROM forge.merge_request_merges WHERE id = <merge_id>; `gstn mr merge-status --project ID --iid N` shows the same. `gstn mr mergeability` shows the conflicted paths once the next check ran.

## 対処 (fix)

Merge the target into the source branch (or rebase it), resolve the conflicts, push, and ask for the merge again with the new head.
